title: Maximum Erasure Value
summary: Given an array of positive integers nums, determine the maximum score by erasing a contiguous subarray that contains unique elements.
statement: Given an array of positive integers nums, determine the maximum score by erasing a contiguous subarray that contains unique elements. The score is calculated as the sum of the elements in the erased subarray. Return the highest possible score that can be achieved by erasing exactly one such subarray.
constraints: Choose one contiguous subarray with all distinct values and maximize its sum.
hints: Positive values mean the best window ending at each index starts immediately after the previous duplicate.
Maintain a unique-value window, its sum, and a left pointer.
While the new value is present, remove left values and their sum; then add it and maximize.
The loop restores uniqueness with the earliest possible left boundary, which maximizes the positive sum for that right endpoint.
editorial: The loop restores uniqueness with the earliest possible left boundary, which maximizes the positive sum for that right endpoint.
